title: Graded DCA run classification block
description: The run_classification object embedded in every run_state artifact. It is the single authoritative signal that distinguishes a scheduled live run of task ce16ba6b from an ad-hoc manual run so downstream slippage/watchdog/weekly reporting never confuses the two. Contains no secrets.

run_origin.description: Authoritative origin of the run. 'scheduled' is reserved for the live cron task ce16ba6b firing inside its window; everything else is 'manual'.

manual_run.description: true for manual runs, false for scheduled runs. Must agree with run_origin: manual_run === (run_origin == 'manual').

run_type.description: Free-form run type label. Scheduled live runs use 'scheduled_live_test'.

cron_id.description: Live scheduled task id. Always 'ce16ba6b' for this strategy, on both scheduled and manual runs, so manual runs can be attributed to the task they emulate.

scheduled_for_et.description: Nominal ET fire time of the scheduled task, HH:MM. '15:20' for scheduled runs; null/omitted for manual runs.

scheduled_window_start_et.description: Inclusive start of the accepted scheduled window in ET, HH:MM ('15:15').

scheduled_window_end_et.description: Inclusive end of the accepted scheduled window in ET, HH:MM ('15:35').

run_id.description: Unique run id. Scheduled: 'scheduled_YYYYMMDD_1520ET'. Manual: a distinct id, e.g. 'manual_YYYYMMDD_HHMMSSZ', that never collides with the scheduled pattern.

triggered_at_utc.description: ISO-8601 UTC timestamp when the run was triggered.

state_schema_version.description: Version tag of the run-classification contract. Pinned to 'run-classification-v1'.
